$comment: Advisories in the RUNTIME dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev) that CI is
knowingly carrying. Read by scripts/audit-check.mjs, which fails the build on
any high or critical advisory that is not listed here, and on any entry whose
expiry has passed. An entry is a decision with a date on it, not a mute button.
Every entry below needs a major-version bump that Phase 1 excludes (D1 pins the
framework majors). Re-test on the review date: if the fix has landed in a patch
or minor, take it and delete the entry.

advisories.title: DeepmergeTS has stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
advisories.reason: Reachable only from the Prisma CLI's config loader, which reads prisma.config.ts at build and migrate time. It never sees request data. The fix is a prisma major, excluded by the D1 pins.

advisories.title: Effect AsyncLocalStorage context lost/contaminated inside Effect fibers under concurrent load with RPC
advisories.reason: Same path as the entry above: the Prisma CLI, not the request path. Relay does not use Effect or its RPC layer. The fix is a prisma major, excluded by the D1 pins.

advisories.title: PostCSS: Arbitrary file read and information disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS comments
advisories.reason: Next pins its own postcss and uses it to compile this repository's CSS at build time. Exploiting it requires attacker-controlled CSS in the build, which would already mean an attacker had commit access. The fix is a Next major, excluded by the D1 pins.

advisories.title: PostCSS: Path Traversal in Previous Source Map Auto-Loading (sourceMappingURL) leads to Arbitrary .map File Disclosure
advisories.reason: Same package and same reasoning as the entry above: build-time CSS only, and the attacker would need to control the CSS in the repository.
